data.name: Usage
data.value:
WindowMinimize - minimize the current window with a hotkey
usage: WindowMinimize.exe [options]
options: --hotkey <combination> the hotkey to use, for example --hotkey Ctrl+Alt+M syntax: a modifier (Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win) plus one main key (A-Z, 0-9, F1-F24, Space, Esc, Enter and so on) joined with +; without a modifier only function keys are allowed --mode <mode> minimize (default, to the taskbar) or hide (hide the window) --config <path> use this config file, defaults to hotkey.ini next to the exe --lang <language> interface language, en or zh, defaults to the system language --debug write a debug log to hotkey.log next to the exe --no-tray do not show the tray icon --help show this help
hotkey.ini example: [general] Hotkey=Win+S Mode=minimize AutoStart=true Debug=false
notes: Started by double click the tool stays in the tray and the hotkey minimizes whatever window is in front. The tray menu minimizes once, suspends the hotkey, opens the config, toggles the auto start and exits. Saving hotkey.ini takes effect right away.

data.name: MsgRestartAdmin
data.value: WindowMinimize will close and restart as administrator. Confirm the UAC prompt to continue.

data.name: BalloonElevatedTarget
data.value: The target window runs as administrator. A normal-privilege program cannot minimize it; restart WindowMinimize as administrator to handle such windows.
